bosses.name: Pyroguard Emberseer
bosses.general: Kill the Blackhand Incarcerators around the room, then free him at the altar: Fire Nova, Fireball Volley, Flame Buffet.
bosses.healer: Heavy fire damage on everyone: fire resistance helps.

bosses.name: Solakar Flamewreath
bosses.general: The rookery: waves of whelps and handlers, then Solakar. Don't break the eggs.
bosses.tank: Hold the handlers and whelps in a corner.
bosses.dps: Handlers first, area attacks on the whelps.

bosses.name: Warchief Rend Blackhand
bosses.general: Waves of orcs and dragonkin pour out of the arena gates, then Rend rides in on Gyth (breaths); when Gyth dies Rend fights on foot: Whirlwind and Cleave.
bosses.tank: Hold the waves in the corner by the entrance; face Gyth away from the group.
bosses.dps: Kill the waves fast; never stand in front of Gyth; step out of Rend's Whirlwind.

bosses.name: The Beast
bosses.general: Fireballs, Flamebreak around him, a roar that fears, and he pulls players to him.
bosses.tank: Fear Ward on you; face him away.

bosses.name: General Drakkisath
bosses.general: Two Chromatic Elite Guards: separate them. Drakkisath: Flamestrike, Cleave, Conflagration disorients his tank.
bosses.tank: Main tank on Drakkisath facing away; off-tank the guards, then take over during Conflagration.
bosses.healer: Heal both tanks; fire resistance helps.
bosses.dps: Guards first, then Drakkisath; step out of Flamestrike.
